connectors.name: Hopae Connect
connectors.description: Sandbox verifier for EUDI Wallet presentations through one REST API. Hopae Connect currently gives customers sandbox access to Germany's d-you wallet and Denmark's AltID wallet. Hopae says that support stays sandbox-only until those wallets are available to businesses in production. OpenID Foundation certification for Hopae Connect covers OpenID4VP 1.0 with HAIP 1.0 for the SD-JWT VC and ISO mdoc verifier profiles.
